svg.title: Minimus architecture
svg.desc: React client, Express API, OMDB and TMDB movie data, Google sign-in and PostgreSQL through Prisma.
svg.text: Discover films and series, keep watchlists
and history, rate and review. Admin tools
Titles are keyed by imdbId; each list holds
one row per user per title.
Reviews are 1 to 5 stars. Admin routes sit
